coach.dawnArrivedBody: All reports and plans have locked in, gold was paid, towers were built, and the battle was fought. Tap <bold>☀ Watch Dawn {{day}}</bold> at the bottom to watch the replay!
coach.completeBody: You completed all 3 days and faced the Boss! In a real challenge, each day stays open until the next morning's Dawn ({{dawnTime}}).
coach.hintScoutDay1: <bold>Step 1 · Scout:</bold> Tap <bold>👁 Scout</bold> (or a red road arrow) to see which roads the horde will attack tonight and what enemy types are marching.
coach.hintScoutDay2: <bold>Day 2 · Tougher foes:</bold> New enemy types unlock as the season progresses. Tap <bold>👁 Scout</bold> to inspect tonight's roads!
coach.hintScoutDay3: <bold>Day 3 · Boss Night!</bold> On the final night (and every 7th day), <bold>{{bossName}}</bold> marches. Tap <bold>👁 Scout</bold> to find the Boss road!
coach.hintReportDay1: <bold>Step 2 · Report your habit:</bold> Tap <bold>✔ Report</bold> to log today's checklist. Hitting your target earns full gold (+72g) and +2 Hero XP; even an honest partial/missed report still earns gold and triggers the <bold>Team Rally</bold> (+15% tower speed)!
coach.hintReportOther: <bold>Step 2 · Report for Day {{day}}:</bold> Tap <bold>✔ Report</bold>. (Tip: try checking only 1 or 2 boxes to see how partial reports still pay gold, or check all 3 for full gold!)
coach.hintOrdersDay1: <bold>Step 3 · Build towers ({{gold}}g available):</bold> Tap a gold <bold>＋</bold> on your plots to build towers (try an <bold>Archer Tower</bold> and a <bold>Barracks</bold>). <bold>⚒ Plan</bold> lists all your plots (build, upgrade, repair) and sets your Hero's stance.
coach.hintOrdersDay2: <bold>Step 3 · Upgrade & share ({{gold}}g available):</bold> Tap a tower with a green <bold>⬆</bold> (or use <bold>⚒ Plan → Your plots</bold>) to <bold>Upgrade</bold> it to Level 2, build a <bold>Mage Tower</bold> against armoured enemies, or donate gold to the <bold>Keep</bold> in <bold>⚒ Plan</bold>.
coach.hintOrdersDay3: <bold>Step 3 · Boss Night prep ({{gold}}g available):</bold> Build/upgrade towers and open <bold>⚒ Plan</bold> to send your <bold>Hero</bold> to reinforce the road the Boss is attacking!
coach.hintReady: <bold>Step 4 · Ready for Dawn {{day}}!</bold> In a real challenge, you'd now wait until tomorrow morning ({{dawnTime}}). In this dry run, tap <bold>⏩ Skip to Dawn {{day}}</bold> below!

tutorial.title: How to Play
tutorial.intro: <bold>The Siege</bold> is a cooperative habit challenge and base-defence game for <bold>2–8 players</bold> over <bold>7–90 days</bold>. Each player guards a sector of the valley; your real-life daily habit reports earn gold and send your hero into battle before the enemy horde attacks at <bold>Dawn</bold>.

timeline.s1Bullet1: • One player creates the challenge: choose a habit type (Yes/No, Checklist, or Numeric target), start date, length (7–90 active days), difficulty, and Dawn time (default 11:00).
timeline.s1Bullet2: • <bold>Share the 6-character invite code:</bold> friends join before the start date and pick their <bold>Hero Class</bold>. Once Day 1 opens, the team roster locks and roads/sectors are assigned.
timeline.s2Title: 2. Every Day & Evening · Report & Plan (00:00 → Dawn next morning)
timeline.s2Intro: Each active day stays open from <bold>00:00</bold> on that calendar day until <bold>Dawn the next morning</bold> (e.g. 11:00 the following day — so you can report in the evening or over breakfast the next morning):
timeline.s2Scout: • <bold>👁 Scout:</bold> Check which roads tonight's wave will march down and what special enemy role is featured.
timeline.s2Report: • <bold>✔ Report:</bold> Log whether you kept your habit for the day. Reporting earns gold, levels up your hero, and sends them to fight tonight.
timeline.s2Plan: • ⚒ Plan & Build: Tap your glowing plots on the map to build, upgrade, or repair towers, set your hero's stance, or share gold. Everything can be edited freely until Dawn!
timeline.s3Title: 3. At Dawn (Next Morning) · The Nightly Assault
timeline.s3StepsIntro: When Dawn arrives, the day closes and resolves automatically in 4 steps:
timeline.s3StepsFlow: <bold>1. Economy</bold> (gold & XP paid, Rally checked) → <bold>2. Orders</bold> (towers built/upgraded, gold shared) → <bold>3. Battle</bold> (enemies march toward the Keep) → <bold>4. Dawn Report</bold> (0–3 ★ stars & MVPs).
timeline.s3Watch: • Open the app anytime after Dawn and tap <bold>☀ Watch Dawn</bold> to watch the battle replay and start planning for the new day.

daily.s1Title: ✔ Step 1: Report Your Habit (Honesty Always Pays!)
daily.s1Intro: Your daily report determines your gold, Hero XP, and Hero status for tonight's battle:
daily.inspired: 🔥 <bold>Inspired (150%+ numeric target):</bold> Base <bold>{{gold}}g</bold> · <bold>+{{xp}} XP</bold> · Hero gets <bold>+20% HP & damage</bold> tonight.
daily.target: ✅ <bold>Target Reached (100%):</bold> Base <bold>{{gold}}g</bold> · <bold>+{{xp}} XP</bold> · Hero fights at full strength.
daily.miss: 🤝 Honest Miss (under 100%): Base {{minGold}}–{{maxGold}}g · +{{xp}} XP · Hero still fights (Weary, −20% dmg). Reporting a miss is always much better than silence!
daily.none: 💤 No Report Submitted: 0g · 0 XP · Hero stays home. After {{dormantAfter}} missed reports in a row, your player is marked Dormant until you report again.
daily.rally: <bold>Team Rally:</bold> Whenever <bold>every</bold> player submits a report (even an honest miss!), a Rally banner flies on the Keep and <bold>all towers fire +15% faster</bold> tonight.
daily.s2Title: ⚒ Step 2: Build Towers, Position Your Hero & Share Gold
daily.s2Plots: • <bold>Tap your glowing plots</bold> (gold <bold>＋</bold> markers) on the valley map to <bold>Build</bold> a Level 1 tower. <bold>Tap a tower you own</bold> to <bold>Upgrade</bold> it (Level 1 → 2 → 3) or <bold>Repair</bold> battle damage — a green <bold>⬆</bold> shows when you can afford an upgrade. <bold>⚒ Plan → Your plots</bold> lists all of them. Every plot reaches the same length of road. Tap <bold>📍</bold> to jump back to your plots.
daily.s2Hero: • <bold>Open ⚒ Plan</bold> to choose where your <bold>Hero</bold> fights tonight: defend your own sector, guard the Keep (last line of defence at the end of every road), or <bold>reinforce a teammate's road</bold> that faces a heavy wave or Boss!
daily.s2Share: • <bold>Share Gold:</bold> In <bold>⚒ Plan</bold>, you can send gold (min {{minDonate}}g) to a teammate who needs a key tower, or donate to the <bold>Keep Fund</bold> ({{fund2}}g → Lv 2, {{fund3}}g → Lv 3 for higher Keep HP and stronger Keep archers).

defenders.towersNote: Towers have {{hpList}} HP (Lv 1/2/3). Siege enemies can damage them; if a tower hits 0 HP it turns into Ruins and must be rebuilt.
defenders.archerRole: Fast single-target physical arrows · hits ground & flying
defenders.barracksRole: Trains footmen who block and fight ground enemies on the road
defenders.mageRole: Magic bolts that ignore armour · hits ground & flying
defenders.catapultRole: Slow, heavy splash damage vs ground clusters · cannot hit flyers
defenders.heroesNote: Heroes gain +12% HP & damage per level and respawn 10s after falling in battle — as long as you reported today!

enemies.heading: {{themeName}} & Counters
enemies.starsLine: • <bold>★★★:</bold> 0 leaks · <bold>★★:</bold> Keep lost ≤10% HP · <bold>★:</bold> Keep survived · <bold>0 ★:</bold> Keep fell.
enemies.noGameOver: • <bold>No Game Over:</bold> If the Keep falls, it is rebuilt at <bold>50% HP</bold> the next morning (and heals +5 HP each day).
enemies.bossNights: • <bold>Boss Nights:</bold> Every 7th active day (in 14+ day seasons) and on the <bold>final night</bold>. Slaying the Boss grants <bold>+1 Bonus Star</bold> and <bold>+{{gold}} gold</bold> to every defender!

dryRunCard.title: 🎯 Interactive Dry Run (3-Day Practice)
dryRunCard.desc: Practice scouting, reporting, building towers, and skipping to Dawn across a guided 3-day mini-season with two bot teammates (<bold>Brin</bold> & <bold>Mara</bold>) — culminating in a Day 3 Boss fight!

priest.name: Priestess
priest.text: Holy magic that ignores armour and heals nearby allies.

roleTips.runner: Fast! Archers and soldiers catch them.
roleTips.brute: Armoured — arrows barely scratch it. Use mages.
roleTips.flyer: Flies over soldiers. Only archers, mages, rangers and priestesses hit it.
roleTips.siege: Smashes buildings in passing. Kill it fast; repair afterwards.
roleTips.boss: Boss. Huge health, speeds up nearby enemies.
